Jay and the entire MJay Photography team are absolutely amazing. Their approach to pre wedding shoots is truly unique, creative and refreshing. Every concept felt thoughtfully designed and executed with great attention to detail.

They are incredibly hardworking, highly professional and extremely supportive throughout the journey. From execution to logistics everything was handled seamlessly and they worked with a wonderful well-coordinated team. A special shoutout to Dharmil who was super warm, patient and very helpful during the video shoots.

The entire process was smooth and extremely well planned. They guide you at every step right from outfit selection to sharing detailed links and references to help you prepare in advance. Jay personally helps in finalizing outfits which makes a huge difference and removes all the stress.

We did our shoot in Mumbai across four themes: High Fashion Beach and Picnic and Night Shoot and each setup was executed beautifully. All our reels came out stunning and our friends and relatives absolutely loved them. In fact some of them are already sure they’ll be reaching out to MJay Photography for their own pre-wedding shoots.

Deliveries were on time and the quality exceeded our expectations.

Highly recommended for anyone looking for a professional yet creative team that truly goes the extra mile to make your pre-wedding experience memorable.

featured_reviews.name: Atisha Jain
featured_reviews.review_text:
We hired this photographer for two preschool events with a fixed rate agreed for both events.
On the morning of the first event, he suddenly demanded ₹500 extra for just 15 additional minutes, which was never discussed during finalization.
The quality of work was extremely poor:
Main events were missed, while irrelevant side moments were covered
Videos were blurry
No noise cancellation during speeches and parent testimonials
Overall output was unusable and disappointing
When we shared our feedback, he initially accepted his mistake. We requested to meet before the second event to clearly guide him on what needed coverage. After this, he stopped answering calls and messages.
As the second event date approached, he:
Increased the price to double the committed amount
Refused to meet or discuss
Claimed he was traveling
Asked for advance payment
Said he would only talk 2 days before the event
To cover up his poor work, he started blaming us for mismanagement, which was completely untrue.
Additional concerns:
Very poor song selection in videos
If changes are requested, he claims he is “too busy” to discuss
No studio address provided; asked us to meet on a roadside while taking advance
Claimed to bring an extra photographer, but that person was clearly inexperienced and delivered badly zoomed, awkward photos that looked like low-quality BTS shots
Overall, this was a highly unprofessional and dishonest experience.
Not recommended at all, especially for important events involving children and parents.

featured_reviews.name: Riddhi Uniclan
featured_reviews.review_text:
We recently had a maternity shoot done by Shruti for my colleague, and the overall experience was wonderful. She was very patient, cooperative, and ensured that the mom-to-be felt completely comfortable and at ease throughout the shoot.

Her creativity and attention to detail were clearly visible during the session. The final pictures are yet to come, but based on the experience itself, we’re confident they will turn out beautiful.

Would definitely recommend her for maternity shoots and special moments!

featured_reviews.name: Sharmin Shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text:
Had the most beautiful experience during my maternity shoot at the crayon studio by Shruti! ✨ From the very beginning, Shruti made me feel so comfortable, confident, and relaxed throughout the entire session. Being pregnant can sometimes make you feel a little conscious or tired, but she was extremely patient, understanding, and supportive the whole time. ❤️  The pictures are absolutely beautiful!!

What I loved the most was how I didn’t even have to think about poses or concepts because she already had so many amazing ideas and guided me so well on what would look best. ✨

If you are looking for a photographer who is talented, warm, professional, and makes your special moments feel effortless, I would highly recommend her. Thank you for making my maternity shoot such a lovely and memorable experience! 🌸

featured_reviews.name: upasana joshi
featured_reviews.review_text:
We had a great experience doing the Photoshoot with Shruti. She was excellent handling my 7 weeks daughter. He was calm and knew how to delicately handle the newbee. We had both grandparents with us and she was mindful in honouring their concerns as they tend to be sceptical about such photo shoots🤪
Besides her friendly nature she is flawless in her work. It took her just a couple of mins to shoot one the baby was in position. She was humble enough to take a few complementary family pictures.
Thankyou for making this seamless experience 🥰🥰

featured_reviews.name: Stuti Dholakia
featured_reviews.review_text:
Shruti’s studio is amazing and she has an incredible level of patience with children and families. Loved her professional approach and quick inputs. Help with dresses and suggestions regarding the outfit as a whole helped a lot. My 1.5 year old daughter was smiling a lot and we all had a good time(family photo shoot)
Would definitely recommend!

featured_reviews.name: Nikunj Shah
featured_reviews.review_text:
Shruti is an expectional photographer. Her patience with the baby and at the same time, being quick enough with the shoots, till the baby is in rest is condemnable.

We, as parents were a bit shy for the shoot, however, Shruti made the environment super comfortable and she has a beautiful studio.

If you want to get your maternity or baby shoot, then 'The Crayon Studio by Shruti' is a no brainer choice.

review_photos.caption: Shruti setting up for the pose.

featured_reviews.name: Ankush Haria
featured_reviews.review_text: We had a wonderful maternity shoot with Shruti! She made us feel completely comfortable and guided us with such creativity and patience. Every pose, expression, and detail was captured beautifully. The final photos are stunning and truly reflect this special moment in our lives. Highly recommend Shruti for anyone looking for a professional and heartfelt maternity shoot!

featured_reviews.name: Sneha Shankar
featured_reviews.review_text: We had a lovely experience with Shruti. The setups were great! Shruti was very loving with our baby as well. All outfits provided were also nice. Shruti clicked a lot of photos and made sure she captured all the good moments. All pictures turned out lovely! Overall, our experience was above expectations :)

featured_reviews.name: Krunal Parmar
featured_reviews.review_text:
We had a really good experience with Shruti for our newborn photoshoot. She was extremely patient and gentle with the baby, which honestly made a huge difference for us as first-time parents. She took her time, never rushed anything, and was very calm throughout the shoot.

Shruti also guided us well on poses and setups, so we didn’t have to worry about anything. The pictures have come out very soft and beautiful, capturing natural moments just the way we wanted. Overall, very happy with her work and would definitely recommend her to anyone looking for a newborn photographer.

featured_reviews.name: Sweety Coutinho
featured_reviews.review_text:
We feel so grateful to have chosen Melroy and his team as our wedding photographer. From our very first interaction, Melroy’s professionalism and reassuring attitude put us completely at ease. He’s truly a man of his word—punctual, organized, and always calm, which was such a relief on a day with so many moving parts.

Melroy  and his team went above and beyond to create a friendly, relaxed atmosphere for our family and friends. It was clear they genuinely love what they do; you could see he and his team having fun as they worked, which made everyone around feel comfortable and helped us all enjoy the moment even more. Their suggestions for poses were creative but never felt forced, and Melroy's clear instructions meant even the camera-shy members of our family didn’t feel awkward at all.

Melroy deserves a special mention for his eye for candid moments—he somehow managed to capture the most beautiful, genuine smiles and hugs, and every photo is filled with honest emotion. Before the big day, he even walked us through the plan, sharing thoughtful tips and ideas so we could just focus on enjoying the experience.

We’re so happy with all the gorgeous pictures and memories Melroy and his team captured for us. We can’t recommend Melroy F photography enough—if you’re considering Melroy for your special day, go ahead without a second thought. We promise you’ll be glad you did!
Thank you, Melroy, for making our wedding memories so precious.

featured_reviews.name: Rahul Pereira
featured_reviews.review_text:
Melroy and his team did an absolutely fabulous job covering our wedding. We’re genuinely in awe of the photos and videos — we’ve been looking at them on repeat ever since we received them!

Melroy clearly understood exactly what we were hoping for and delivered beyond our expectations, and everything was shared with us right on time. What impressed us the most was that we didn’t need to ask for a single edit on any of the work he delivered — it was that good.

Thank you, Melroy, for capturing our special moments so beautifully. Wishing you and your team continued success!

featured_reviews.name: Elvita Fernandes
featured_reviews.review_text:
We had Melroy and his amazing team shoot both our pre-wedding and wedding, and honestly… what a ride it was with them! From climbing the most random rocks during our pre-wedding shoot to coming up with poses we didn’t even know we could pull off — they made everything feel effortless and fun.
What really stood out was how much they cared. Melroy met us beforehand, actually listened to what we wanted, understood our vibe, and then delivered it all (and more!) so beautifully. They didn’t just capture moments — they caught all the chaos, emotions, and little in-between memories that make a wedding real.
And on the big day, when things could’ve easily felt overwhelming, Melroy somehow turned into part photographer, part calm-your-nerves coach 😄 He kept us relaxed, reassured us constantly, and made sure we actually enjoyed every bit of it without stressing.
Also, if any brides out there are looking for someone who’ll hype you up like a bridesmaid while also fixing your veil, carrying your dress, and making sure you look perfect in every shot — you know who to call 🤣
Couldn’t have asked for a better team to capture such an important time in our lives 🤍✨

featured_reviews.name: Sharon Mascarenhas
featured_reviews.review_text:
Your creativity, patience, and eye for detail truly brought our day to life. Every picture tells a story, and we’ll cherish these memories forever. A big thank you to you and your entire team for the incredible effort and passion you put into your work.✨

A Big Thank you 🫶🏻
- Akshay & Sharon

featured_reviews.name: Jolynn Henriques
featured_reviews.review_text:
Melroy and his team did a wonderful job in capturing all moments of our special day.
Melroy made Me and Keith feel completely at ease in front of the camera lens.
It’s hard to describe how happy we are and totally blown away by your skills✨
Thanks a lot for turning our pics around so quick.
We just love them ❤️

featured_reviews.name: Joann Correia
featured_reviews.review_text:
We are incredibly grateful to Melroy and his wonderful team of videographers and photographers for capturing our wedding on 8th November. From the very beginning, they were warm, calm, patient and extremely professional. He was always ready and open to suggestions and would make time to meet inspite of his busy schedule.
Melroy, Shashank and team were truly more than a photographer/videographer —Melroy was like a bridesmaid and emcee always present, reassuring us, guiding and  helping with little things like adjusting my bouquet etc and easing nervousness , and making sure everything stayed on track. His punctuality and dedication gave us so much peace of mind on such an important day of our lives. His eye for detail for taking unique innovative and candid shots are really awesome and worth the capture. He has an eye for capturing the most special moments in a way that feels effortless and natural.
On our big day, they made us feel completely at ease and captured every emotion so naturally—the laughter, the tears, emotions and all the love. Each photograph, Instagram reel and short highlights video tells a story and instantly takes us back to those special moments.Melroy and his team is highly recommended for all your events photography and videography to make your events memorable.

- Solomon & Joann

featured_reviews.name: Celsa Gonsalves
featured_reviews.review_text:
If there were more stars to offer, I would definitely do that since 5 stars are not enough.

We couldn’t be more thrilled with our experience working with Melroy Photography and The Whole Team! From the very beginning, we planned everything remotely and were working with a very short timeline — but none of that felt like an issue thanks to their professionalism, communication, and genuine passion for what they do.

Even before the wedding day, he made us feel completely at ease. Every detail was discussed clearly, and despite the distance, we felt confident that we were in good hands. On the day of the wedding, Melroy and the Team showed up with such calm energy and blended in so naturally. They captured every important moment without ever making it feel forced or overly posed.

When we received the final photos (so quickly, by the way!), we were absolutely blown away. The quality, the lighting, the framing — everything was just stunning. Every image tells a story and brings back the emotions of that day so vividly. We keep going back through them and discovering new favorite moments each time. It’s clear how much thought, creativity, and care went into every shot.

It honestly felt like Melroy understood us, our style, and the vibe we wanted, even though we weren’t able to meet in person until the big day. That alone speaks volumes.

We are so incredibly grateful for the beautiful memories they captured for us. If you're looking for a talented, reliable, and thoughtful photographer, we can't recommend Melroy Photography and his whole Team enough. Thank you again for making our day so special and giving us memories we’ll treasure for a lifetime!

featured_reviews.name: noela monteiro
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had Melroy capture my roce and wedding. Before the event he had a very detailed conversation with us as to how the day would go, timings, pictures and videos which really helped us understand the flow of events. On the actual day, even though at times we were late he managed to adjust and capture most of what he could get and cover up for our delay. When it came to ideas, his team and him were very spontaneous and creative with poses and where to shoot within the location which led to us getting the most amazing shots ever! We even got many candid shots as well! The video was put together very thoughtfully capturing our beautiful memories. We also had a lot of fun during this, not once were we exhausted during our shoot inspite of our early and busy schedule. He was very prompt with providing the pictures and videos. He is very professional, patient, understanding and we loved having him for both our events.
Thankyou ❤️
ShauNoe
